card.name: Negation words that start a contrast
card.fires_on: Negating words like "not" and the "n't" of doesn't or don't, right after a verb or "but". Also some linking words where a negative or contrasting statement follows.

modes.label: not after is/are/but
modes.description: The word "not" appears after a form of "be" or after "but", stating what something is not.

modes.label: n't contractions
modes.description: The "'t" ending of doesn't or don't, before a statement that something does not matter or apply.
modes.example: Ask your students to trace the pattern on construction paper (color doesn<<'t>> matter).

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A verb or conjunction in a sentence that sets up a limit, exception or contrast.
modes.example: are interesting<< but>> will take some long-term effort.

card.writes: It seems to push toward negative or contrast phrasing, such as "neither" and "not", and away from positive or beneficial wording.
card.plain: It lights up on "not" and "n't" where a sentence says something is not the case or does not matter.
